lead.t: – Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) are all the other mycobacteria which can cause pulmonary disease resembling tuberculosis, lymphadenitis, skin disease, or disseminated disease.

snip.t: – Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) are all the other mycobacteria which can cause pulmonary disease resembling tuberculosis, lymphadenitis, skin disease, or disseminated disease.
● Nontuberculous mycobacteria ● Anergy: absence of normal immune response to particular antigen or allergen
● Inappropriate drug “if someone had Nontuberculous mycobacteria and you used anti-TB drugs”

Conditions covered: Community-Acquired Bacterial and Viral Pneumonias · Hospital-Acquired Pneumonias · Aspiration Pneumonia · Lung Abscess · Tuberculosis · Nontuberculous Mycobacteria · Fungal Infections · Pneumonia in Immunocompromised Host · HIV Pulmonary Disease

qs.q: What modern alternative to the TST can successfully distinguish between Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection, nontuberculous mycobacteria, and the BCG vaccine?
qs.e: Quantiferon-TB Gold is an interferon-gamma release assay that serves as a modern alternative capable of distinguishing M. tuberculosis from BCG and other mycobacteria. Sputum smears do not differentiate these mycobacterial species.

qs.q: Which modern interferon-gamma release assay can successfully distinguish Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection from both nontuberculous mycobacteria and the BCG vaccine?
qs.e: QuantiFERON-TB Gold is an IGRA that is able to distinguish M. tb from other mycobacteria and the BCG vaccine. The Mantoux test can yield false positives due to prior BCG vaccination.
